media.alt_text: U.S. Coast Guard Petty Officer 2nd Class Denzel Canty and Petty Officer 3rd Class Drew Freiheit, maritime enforcement specialists assigned to USCGC Hamilton (WMSL 753), conduct a tactical exercise with members of the Finnish Border Guard’s Special Intervention Unit while underway in the Baltic Sea, Nov. 3, 2022. Hamilton is on a scheduled deployment in the U.S. Naval Forces Europe area of operations, employed by U.S. Sixth Fleet to defend U.S., allied and partner interests. (U.S. Coast Guard photo by Petty Officer 3rd Class Alejandro Rivera)

Crewmembers assigned to USCGC Hamilton (WMSL 753) give a tour of Hamilton to members of the Estonian Police and Border Guard and Estonian Naval Forces, Nov. 10, 2022. Hamilton is on a scheduled deployment in the U.S. Naval Forces Europe area of operations, employed by U.S. Sixth Fleet to defend U.S., allied and partner interests. (U.S. Coast Guard photo by Ensign Joshua Romano)

U.S. Coast Guard Ensign Kyra Hartman, a junior officer aboard USCGC Hamilton (WMSL 753), uses a laser range finder to monitor distances to the Lithuanian Naval Forces vessel LNS Aukštaitis (P14) during a simulated fueling at-sea during an exercise, Nov. 14, 2022. Hamilton is on a scheduled deployment in the U.S. Naval Forces Europe area of operations, employed by U.S. Sixth Fleet to defend U.S., allied and partner interests. (U.S. Coast Guard photo by Ensign Joshua Romano)

Deck force crewmembers assigned to USCGC Hamilton (WMSL 753) take in mooring lines while getting underway from Riga, Latvia, Nov. 19, 2022. Hamilton is on a scheduled deployment in the U.S. Naval Forces Europe area of operations, employed by U.S. Sixth Fleet to defend U.S., allied and partner interests. (U.S. Coast Guard photo by Ensign Bryce Sturtz)
